title: Raw finish - but more thAn just a ‘bamboo’ turner.
text: Raw finish - but more thAn just a ‘bamboo’ turner.. Something with  the new design of spoons, spatulas: they feel a little rough, not polished.  Whilst I like the Raw feel, there were some open ends, which were sealed once I started cooking with it.  I am kinda in two minds about it, but I do like the look, and the handle feels like a farmhouse cooking experience.  The handle is quite short though.
